'''Jobal Naberrie''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. A member of the [[Naberrie family]],<ref name="Force Collection" /> she was the [[Parent|mother]] of [[Sola Naberrie]] and [[Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Card Trader">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Padmé Naberrie - Handmaiden}}</ref> Her younger daughter, who was [[Reproduction|born]] Padmé Naberrie before assuming the name Amidala, served as [[Monarch of Naboo|queen]] and later as the [[Senator|representative]] of their [[homeworld]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] during [[Republic Era|final years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Padmé Databank">{{Databank|padme-amidala|Padmé Amidala}}</ref>

==Biography==
===Early life===
Jobal married a man named [[Ruwee Naberrie]], and they had two daughters, [[Sola Naberrie|Sola]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> and [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Naberrie]].<ref name="BioGal1" />

Ruwee and Jobal Naberrie had spent the first years of their lives with their daughters Padmé and Sola helping build a small village hidden in one of Naboo's mountain ranges. A strong-shouldered individual, Ruwee was a skilled builder and an integral part of all construction efforts. Despite the emotional and physical contributions she and Jobal made to the village during the founding of the house, they both felt that their two young daughters, born there, would benefit from growing up in Theed's cosmopolitan environment. Without remorse, they left the village when their children were still young and went to the capital city of Naboo.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Anakin Skywalker}}</ref>

They chose a solid house with an elegant design that Ruwee had admired from the very beginning, and it had seen several generations come and go, witnessing the many changes that Naboo went through. Everything about the home spoke of permanence and reflected Naboo's enduring values of generosity and neighborliness. It was also the fact that their elder daughter, Sola, lived near her parents and could visit them almost daily. His proximity compensated for the fact that Padmé was such an itinerant politician, and he was happy.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

When Padmé turned [[26 BBY|fourteen]], she [[Coronation of Queen Amidala|was]] [[Democracy|elected]] [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen of Naboo]] and adopted the name "Padmé Amidala."<ref name="BioGal1" />Successful and well-liked, she served two two-[[Standard year|year]] terms, including during the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. Though she'd planned to retire from public life, Padmé was asked by her successor, [[Réillata]], to represent [[Naboo]] in the Senate. That same [[Standard day|day]] she informed Ruwee and Jobal of her decision.<ref name="Shadow" />

In [[28 BBY]],<ref name="28 BBY">In ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'', [[Padmé Amidala]] states that [[Sola Naberrie|her sister]] has just had her [[Ryoo Naberrie|first baby]]. The main story of the novel takes place 4 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[32 BBY]].</ref> Jobal's daughter Sola had her first baby, [[Ryoo Naberrie|Ryoo]], making Jobal a grandmother.<ref name="Shadow" /> Shortly before the Clone Wars, her daughter Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker visited them.<ref name="Family at War">''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]''</ref>

===Death of Padmé===
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> following the [[Clone Wars]] and the execution of [[Order 66]], Jobal, Ruwee and Sola attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral of Padmé]] after her [[death]] at [[Polis Massa]].<ref name="Episode III" />

==Personality and traits==
Jobal Naberrie had brown [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Equipment==
During her daughter's funeral, Jobal wore a black robe and black mourning [[cloak]], with the dark tones reflecting the family's sadness and mourning at Amidala's death.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In deleted scenes for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], Jobal Naberrie was established as the mother of Padmé Amidala.<ref name="Episode II deleted scenes">{{Film|II}} deleted scenes</ref> She was portrayed by [[Trisha Noble]], who reprised the role for Amidala's funeral in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS credits">{{Film|III}} credits</ref>
